strings.name: Sajjan Jindal
strings.role: JSW Group chairman; JSW Steel chairman and managing director
strings.summary: Sajjan Jindal is an Indian industrial entrepreneur trained in mechanical engineering who expanded JSW from steel into energy, infrastructure, cement and other sectors. He formerly chaired the World Steel Association and received India’s EY Entrepreneur of the Year award; business expansion has also brought regulatory scrutiny.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Distinguishes group and listed-company roles, past association terms, award year and presentation date, and antitrust investigation findings and final rulings.
strings.influence.rationale: He developed JSW Group’s steel, energy and infrastructure businesses and participated in industrial investment and expansion in India.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering; EY lists Bangalore University as the awarding institution. Graduation year was not confirmed in this review.
strings.facts.f2.label: Current roles
strings.facts.f2.value: He chairs JSW Group and is chairman and managing director of JSW Steel, whose CEO is Jayant Acharya.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Diversifying industrial businesses
strings.highlights.h1.text: He expanded from steel into energy, infrastructure including ports, cement and paints across several distinct companies.
strings.highlights.h2.title: International industry governance
strings.highlights.h2.text: He chaired the World Steel Association in 2021–2022, then served as vice-chairman for the 2022–2023 term.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Meeting West Bengal’s chief minister
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Times of India reported discussions on industrial expansion and social projects; plans under discussion are not completed developments.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Antitrust investigation reported
strings.timeline.t2.text: Reuters reported investigation findings involving him and JSW; the company denied the allegations and a final ruling was pending then. No subsequent final outcome was verified in this review.
strings.timeline.t3.title: JSW Infrastructure lists
strings.timeline.t3.text: The group’s infrastructure company began trading on Indian stock exchanges.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Receiving India’s EY entrepreneurship award
strings.timeline.t4.text: He won India’s overall award for 2022, presented in 2023; this was not the world title.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becoming worldsteel vice-chairman
strings.timeline.t5.text: Jeong-Woo Choi succeeded him as chairman, while Jindal became vice-chairman for the new term.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Elected worldsteel chairman
strings.timeline.t6.text: He was elected for the 2021–2022 term of one year.
strings.timeline.t7.title: First appointment to the steel company’s board
strings.timeline.t7.text: JSW Steel’s director biography records this as his first board appointment date.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Beginning a steel industry career
strings.timeline.t8.text: He started work at a steel plant and later developed industrial management and investment activities.
